title: FP8 adaptive hysteresis and shadow-traffic validation for Hopper (e4m3/e5m2)
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Purpose: enable an FP8 profile activation flow on Hopper hardware (e4m3/e5m2) that minimizes customer-visible accuracy regressions while maximizing cost savings. Scope: introduce an adaptive hysteresis controller for profile activation, a shadow-traffic validator that exercises production-like prefixes, and telemetry gates (accuracy, latency, token stability) to drive automated rollback.

Approach:
- Calibration pipeline: extend the existing per-shard calibration job to emit per-op scale statistics and activation confidence metrics. Calibration outputs are canonicalized into a profile bundle that includes scale histograms, outlier counts, and a profile checksum.
- Adaptive hysteresis: implement a controller that requires N consecutive calibration windows to exceed a stability threshold before activating a profile on a shard. Hysteresis parameters are workload-aware (sequence-length buckets) and tuned to reduce flip-flop under bursty traffic.
- Shadow-traffic validator: route a configurable fraction (0.5% -> 5%) of live requests in shadow to the FP8 path; collect paired outputs for automated accuracy checks (embedding cosine, logprob delta, and structured-output token diffs). Validator runs in-band but non-perturbing to latency-critical paths.
- Telemetry and gates: build composite SLO checks combining token-level divergence, tail latency P99, and failure rates. Composite gate evaluates on rolling windows and triggers canary rollback or extended shadowing if thresholds breach.
- Rollout plan: lab synthetic runs -> shadow for 48-72h on subset customers -> canary (1%) with automated rollback gating -> progressive ramp to 25%/50%/100%.

Acceptance criteria:
- No sustained accuracy regression > 1.0% on the golden prompt set (30k prompts) and per-customer samples.
- Latency increase < 5% p50 and < 10% p99 compared to INT8 baseline.
- Telemetry shows stable KV cache hit parity and no increase in OOMs or retries.

Trade-offs & notes:
- Conservative hysteresis delays first-time activation to avoid oscillation; this increases time-to-benefit for low-traffic customers.
- Shadow validator adds additional token-level telemetry; storage overhead estimated at +8% TT storage for 72h retention.
- We prioritize rollback safety over immediate cost savings for initial rollout (P0).
